verdict.rationale: Tilled exposes API surfaces for payouts, disputes, and webhooks (docs-10, docs-11, docs-22, docs-4/23) and a live REST API confirmed by a runtime probe, so an agent could plausibly read balances/payouts and draft dispute evidence via the DisputesAPI. However, payout and dispute management are largely documented as Dashboard-driven workflows rather than fully agent-scriptable endpoints, and there's no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index (tilled-probe-rt-2), meaning agent-usability is not explicitly designed for. missing for 10: documented read endpoints for balances/payouts usable headlessly by an agent, an agent-facing docs/llms.txt index, and evidence of end-to-end automated dispute-evidence drafting via API rather than console UI.
